prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate exactly ONE new image and save it as public/assets/tien-de-v1/heaven-court.png (create the folder if needed). Target approximately 9:16 portrait (e.g. 941 x 1672). Full-bleed opaque PNG.
Rendering-quality reference only: the attached image has painterly semi-realistic xianxia environment art. Match that polish but design an entirely NEW location: NOT space, NOT mountains.
Scene: the imperial coronation court of the Heavenly Court at dawn. Upper 55 percent: a radiant sky of golden-crimson dawn clouds, a vast sea of clouds, sunbeams, and far in the upper distance a colossal floating imperial palace complex of white jade with golden glazed roofs, red pillars and layered eaves, very majestic but distant and slightly hazy. Middle: a long wide white-jade imperial avenue with carved dragon balustrades stretches back toward the palace, lined far away by tall vermilion banners poles (no people).
Lower 30 percent: a wide grand white jade coronation plaza seen at a slight angle, carved with a golden imperial sun-and-cloud medallion; its visual centre at x=50%, y=78% of the image, leaving room for a character to stand there later. Gold and vermilion ornamental details only toward the sides.
Composition: keep the central column x=35-65%, y=40-85% relatively clean, calm, mid-brightness so a character silhouette reads clearly. Imperial palette: gold, vermilion red, white jade, warm dawn light, a touch of cool blue shadow. Dignified, monumental, celebratory.
No characters, no people, no creatures, no dragons as living beings, no text, no lettering, no UI, no watermark. No borders.
